scope.population: Standalone menu items in the published SCU menu audit, including beverages and standalone sides.
scope.counting_rule: Count distinct local calendar dates across cafés, merging repeated normalized item names.
scope.occurrence_date_ranges: Each date-range pair includes both endpoints. For other dates in a range use the dated URL template with the occurrence café slug.
scope.nutrition_basis: Café Bon Appétit nutrition fields are reproduced as published, with their original serving labels and units. Size listings do not imply nutrition for every size. Empty publisher values are unknown. The catalog block separately records any existing app estimates.
scope.primary_variant_rule: Prefer a variant with published nutrients, then one with published calories, then the most dates listed within each group.
scope.image_basis: Ready means a verified generated original PNG or an existing bundled artwork file matched before this generation run. entry.path remains relative to this manifest.

dish:blueberry-muffin.name: Blueberry Muffin
dish:blueberry-muffin.prompt: Match the supplied reference photo for lighting and presentation only. Photorealistic overhead bakery menu cutout. Show exactly one golden freshly baked blueberry muffin with a natural domed cracked top and a few dark baked blueberry spots visible in the crumb. No loose berries, icing, dusting, liner, bowl or plate. Center the complete muffin at about 65% of the square canvas width with even margins. Shoot straight down at 90 degrees. Use soft diffused studio light from the upper left, natural colors and believable food textures. Export a square PNG with true alpha. Keep only the subject and a short soft contact shadow fading into transparency. No extra ingredients, sauces, garnish, text, logos, hands, utensils, props, surfaces, solid background or checkerboard.

verification.visual: One golden blueberry muffin with visible baked berries and a full vessel-free silhouette.
